name: Grilled Chicken Fajita Breast with White Rice (Customized)
whyItWorks: Marinated lean chicken breast seared without heavy charring provides ultra-lean protein. Customizing to skip the bell peppers and onions removes insoluble vegetable skins that provoke cramping in active IBD.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order chicken fajitas with chicken breast only (no onions or bell peppers), served with soft flour or corn tortillas and side white rice.
